tools.name: OpusClip
tools.tagline: Turn long videos into viral shorts
tools.description: OpusClip analyzes long-form videos using AI virality scoring to extract the highest-retention vertical clips. Auto-captions, emojis, and smart reframing included.
tools.priceCheckNote: Official pricing page; USD. Starter is monthly-only; Pro annual equivalent is $14.50/mo.

pricingPlans.name: Free
features: AI captions with emoji and keyword highlighting
pricingPlans.differenceFromPrevious: Entry tier; clips become non-exportable after 3 days.

pricingPlans.name: Starter
features: Auto-post to YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels
pricingPlans.differenceFromPrevious: Adds exporting, editor, posting, Virality Score and brand template; no annual option.

pricingPlans.name: Pro
features: 3,600 annual credits, available instantly on annual billing
pricingPlans.differenceFromPrevious: Adds team workspace, extra template and substantially higher credits; annual billing reduces effective monthly price.

Whether a regeneration is free is indicated before generating. What happens if I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel my subscription? If you upgrade to a higher plan, any unused credits from your previous plan will roll over into the next billing cycle. If you downgrade or cancel your subscription, your subscription will remain active until the end

embers Workspace members can be invited by clicking Invite Members in the top-right workspace module, or heading to Workspace Settings and selecting Members. Invites are sent via email with a secure link for the user to accept the invitation. Invitation charges All added admins and editors are subject to an additional charge upon invitation. The charge is equivalent to the rate paid by the initial workspace owner. For instance, if the owner pays $30 a month for a PRO Plan, any added admins or editors will also be charged $30/month (per added member) upon invitation. Removing an invited user will add the remaining balance of their plan as an invoice credit to the owner's account. Invoice credits are a monetary balance that will be spent on future transactions before charging the account owner's payment method. Roles Workspace roles can be adjusted under Workspace Settings > Members by using the dropdown menus in the Role column. Permissions are as follows: Owner Owner is only assigned to you in your original, default workspace. Owners cannot be removed from their workspace. This role cannot be assigned in newly created workspaces. Admin Admins can adjust workspace roles, and edit and view results and assets.
